Results.ReviewText: Excellent compact full service grill for our small patio space.
Results.Title: Excellent Full Service Grill

Results.ReviewText: My Genesis grill was crushed by falling tree branches. It was actually too big, so decided to purchase the Spirit E-325 as the replacement. It is the right size for the majority of meals I cook for small groups.
Results.Title: Smaller Grill

Results.ReviewText: Works great very happy with the grill.  It did come damaged, but webber quickly sent replacement parts.  It would be nice if it had a back, but that isn't a big deal to me.  The build quality is really good and the burners get really hot!  Makes grilling fun again!  Assembly was very easy.
Results.Title: 3 burner natural gas grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill comes cleverly packaged to protect contents. Assembly requires layingout all pieces on the ground then following the instructions carefully. The materials are more sturdy than expected given the poor metals used in the kitchen applicance industry. Used immediately with no problems so far.
Results.Title: Well designed, sturdy construction,  good cooking!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber grill.  It’s terrific.  It was so easy to set up upon delivery.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: This is a very nice Weber.  If you haven't purchased a new grill in a while, you will find the instructions to be helpful.  I like how each burner ignites by pushing in the associated temp knob.  The grill is easy to use, and the temperatures can be set at predictable levels.  The grill looks good and is very maneuverable.
Results.Title: This Grill Has Good Features

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill.  The only issue is that the middle burner is finicky about lighting.  The two outside burners light first time every time.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-325 Review

Results.ReviewText: I've had the Weber silver series for 20 or 30 years.So we've been happy with that grill and i'm hoping it'll this gonna be just as good as good last is long
Results.Title: Sizzling great

Results.ReviewText: Grill met most expectations. Only fault was trying to find an adapter for the quick connect to my house. This should be included.
Results.Title: Great Grill, needs adapter.

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill, quality is very nice. Grill gets very hot, and is the perfect size for my family.
Results.Title: Well built quality

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback regarding the Spirit E-325. So sorry to hear your experience did not meet your expectations. We will be sure to share your comments with our team for consideration. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this same 3 burner grill in 2024 and love it so decided to buy again for our other home.  Very disappointed that changes were made.  Grill surface is smaller, 2 fewer “tents” in the burn area and 2 wheels on bottom vs 4.  Same price though.
Results.Title: Good Grill — But not Same

Results.ReviewText: So far very pleased. Had issue with dent in door, contacted Weber and within a week had a new door. That is great response.
Results.Title: Happy so far

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber grill.  This is the first time I have owned a Weber grill.  I have avoided them in the past due to the high price.  However, I splurged this time because I am retired and can afford spoiling myself now... and I am so glad I did.  There are very few hot spots like my older cheap grills, which means the food all gets cooked at the same rate.  Having a thermometer on it allows me to better monitor my cooking process as well.  I am VERY happy and recommend buying a Weber to anyone!
Results.Title: I love my new Weber Spirit® E-325 Gas grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the Spirit BBQ grill I recently purchased. It is a small three burner grill and is easy to wheel around my patio. The two right hand burners have a boost feature that turns up the heat and puts grill marks on the meat you are grilling. Plus it is a great looking grill.
Results.Title: Love the Spirit!!

Results.ReviewText: Delivers the right amount of heat whether I'm using one grate or both making my outdoor cooking easy to prepare a delicious dish.
Results.Title: Perfect Performance

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are so happy to hear you are enjoying your new Spirit E-325. Our Care team will be reaching out to follow up. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: This summer I broke down and got a Weber Spirit E-325 Gas Grill and I'm so glad I did. In the past I would buy what was on sale at the hardware store. It would last about two years and I grill all year round in upstate New York. At the end of its life, it would give me an uneven cook. I look forward to a long time of cooking memories with this new grill.
Results.Title: The Weber Spirit E-325 is just the right size!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill perfect size and the sear is awesome recommend to anyone
Results.Title: Perfect cooking even in any part of the grill

Results.ReviewText: I replaced a Weber I’ve had since 1999 that finally rusted out.   It still cooked but the bottom basically fell out.  I think I got my moneys worth.   Bought this one based on the size and features for the money.  Lowe’s assembled it for me at no additional cost so I picked it up and it was ready to roll.  Cooked on it several times and I like the cast iron grates rather than the enamel I had before.   Very pleased so far.  Hope it lasts as long as the last one.
Results.Title: Go to Weber Quality!

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. So sorry to hear about your experience with the gap in the cooking grates. We will be sure to share your comment with our team for consideration. If you need further assistance please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The grates are to far apart and most food falls down thru the grates. Had to buy after market grates closer together to fix the problem.
Results.Title: Great Grill --Bad grate design

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback and are really sorry to hear of your experience. A frosted regulator is an indication of an overfilled propane tank. Please be sure the tank is returned and purged of the excess gas or exchanged. Our apologies for the wait time due to the part not being available in stock. Thank you for your patience.

Results.ReviewText: Grill cut off during first use. Regulator was frosted over. Spoke to Weber they told me not to use grill. They are sending me a part sometime in October. So, I will have owned the grill for over two months without being able to use it. That stinks.
Results.Title: Broken Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. So sorry to hear you are not completely satisfied with the quality of your grill. It is backed by a generous warranty that we will always stand behind. We will be sure to share your comments with our team for consideration. If you need immediate assistance, please reach out direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Side shelves are junk. Awkward to move around. Wheels are junk. Fame flexes easily. Not the quality I’d expect from Weber.
Results.Title: Decent

Results.ReviewText: This grill is so easy to use. I wish I bought it sooner!
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText:
This four burner does everything!
Grill, roast, bake and more. Retaining heat with minimal flame. With a little practice, anyone can grill like a pro.
Results.Title: Impressive!!!

Results.ReviewText: Cooks great…. Unfortunately I screwed up by not comparing cooking surface of old spirit with new one and it sure seems like a smaller cooking surface with 3 burners….. also I live in Florida and hide my cigar ashtray inside the bottom of grill but this new model seems to allow rain water to fill grease tray and overflow when not covered which made a real mess of my cigar ashtray
Results.Title: Grill Great

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are sorry to hear about the loud noise when closing and opening the lid. Our Care Team will reach out to assist in resolving this issue. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: When opening and closing the lid, the parts rub against each other making a loud annoying noise.  The lid interferes with the base piece.
Results.Title: Average

Results.ReviewText: Great compact grill, does everything the bigger ones do, easy to work.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Great 3 burner grill without side burner.  Heats very fast, provides a great sear on steaks and burgers.  Grate is easily cleaned with wire brush after use.  Only caution is hood handle gets very hot especially if all 3 burners are on.
Results.Title: Quick and easy burner lighting without batteries.

Results.ReviewText: So far so good- only have cooked on it a couple times so far. Top of grill (cook box, lid & burners) seem top notch. Wish the wheels weren't so cheap..we'll see how those (and the skirt/bottom of grill) hold up.
Results.Title: Spirit E-325

Results.ReviewText: A little wonder!  Smaller in size than the older model, but so much easier to operate and the same amount of grilling area
Results.Title: A little wonder!

Results.ReviewText: I owned a Weber Genesis previously which was fantastic and wanted to downsize this time. This one is not built quite as stout as the Genesis but still fantastic for grilling. Only real disappointment is the cheap plastic wheels. Look forward to using it for years to come.
Results.Title: Love Weber

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. Our Care Team will follow up with you shortly. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Would give it a 5 star if it came with the stainless steel grates.  Can u recommend grates that will fit in stainless steel,  thanks
Results.Title: Stainless steel grates would be nice

Results.ReviewText: Individual burner starting is good and cooking is great, but the OPEN BACK design with only a pair of 3" metal strips for stability is a POOR DESIGN that does not keep the weather or animals out of the inside of the grill - I had to add my own weather block across the back
Results.Title: Great cooking poor structure design

Results.ReviewText: Our third Weber grill in our lifetime. Simply great product.
Results.Title: Weber once again

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. We are sorry to hear you were missing parts for your grill. Our Care Team will follow up to make sure this has been resolved. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: We love the grill but unfortunately the package was sent with a few missing parts so we had to call customer service on two different occasions to have the parts reshipped to us delaying the use of the grill
Results.Title: Missing parts could not assemble right away

Results.ReviewText: Really solid,well built grill. The sear zone works great!Should last a long time.
Results.Title: Weber Quality

Results.ReviewText: I just got it , works well, excellent product,very simple and easy to use
Results.Title: Dream grill

Results.ReviewText: Just as great as my old one.  I love the SEAR ZONE.
Results.Title: Love the Sear Zone

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback means a lot to us. So sorry to hear you are experiencing an issue lighting the grill. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
I love this BBQ but I do not like how you have to ignite all 3 dials - it's difficult to get to ignite all 3 together .  I find that 2 ignite no problem and the 3rd one does not and you have to wait 5 mins for the gas to clear to try to ignite the bbq again, for this I only rated it 3 stars
Size is great and it's nice and compact.  I just wish it had one single ignition and not 3!
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-325 BBQ

Results.ReviewText: I love my new E-325. It was very easy to build and it feels of great quality. I love how it starts up the flames and how well it cooks the food. I also love how easy it is to clean the grill. The only improvement that could be made is to make the feet on the non-wheel side adjustable to keep it level and from wobbling. Most patios are not completely level either for rain runoff or because of the texture of the ground, so having adjustable feet that can avoid the wobble and would make this nearly perfect.
Results.Title: Perfect in every way, except make feet adjustable

Results.ReviewText: The Weber E-325 Gas Grill is a very good grill.  Pros: The sear function on it is great but takes a little time to get use to since the temperature gets very high.  Clean up is easy with a good brush.  Con:  The holding grate above the main grates is a little narrow.  I ended up turning down a burner for holding food but gives you less space for grilling.  Overall a very good grill for 2-4 people.
Results.Title: Great for 2-4 people

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback on the Spirit E-325 Gas Grill. We are sorry to hear it is not heating up your cast-iron griddle. Our Care Team will reach out to check on this issue for you. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The little Spirit e225 natural gas grill can get very hot with the sear zone burners on. However it isn’t able to keep my heavy cast iron griddle hot as it cooks the food. As soon as you put the food on the griddle begins to cook and the burners simply can’t keep up, especially if the lid is opened to tend to things.  I don’t know if the larger 425 is able to keep up, but I wish I had bought the larger grill just to have room for the griddle and some open flame grill area at the same time.
Results.Title: Ok not as good as hoped
